intro: A selection of things I have built.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Internet Radio Streaming Platform
projects.description: Built and hosted a multi-tenant internet radio platform: Go for audio streaming, Python/Django for APIs and station management, and React for the UI/dashboard. Designed the streaming service to support at least 1,000 concurrent listeners.

projects.title: AJA Store - Transaction Platform
projects.description: Developed backend services for real-time transaction processing and built analytics dashboards with live data updates.
